cases.prompt: Apply the public woostack-review boundary to these requested invocations without calling GitHub, providers, Linear, or changing files: `/woostack-review 602`, `/woostack-review`, `/woostack-review --fast`, and a request to inspect the current working-tree diff. Return exactly one JSON object with keys accepted, acceptedCommand, rejectedCommands, localDiffAdmitted, publicTierVariants, and readOnly. The exact existing PR command is the only accepted public mode; internal worker tiers may still exist but are not public commands.
cases.expected: Only `/woostack-review 602` is accepted; missing-PR, tier-variant, and working-tree requests are rejected, and review remains read-only.

assertions.rubric: Does rejectedCommands include the missing-PR invocation, --fast invocation, and working-tree/local-diff request?

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded exact-PR review plan without dispatching agents, calling providers, posting, or editing files. The plan detects angles bugs, security, and simplify, dispatches one worker for each detected angle, then runs exactly one prosecutor pass and exactly one defender pass before deterministic intersection. Return exactly one JSON object with keys detectedAngles, swarmPasses, prosecutorPasses, defenderPasses, intersectionPasses, mergeBeforeValidation, and codeEdits.
cases.expected: All detected angles run in one multi-angle swarm pass; both adversarial validators run once; intersection follows validation; no code edit occurs.

assertions.rubric: Does the response report exactly one prosecutor pass and exactly one defender pass?

cases.prompt: Apply the exact-PR reporting boundary to two already-intersected finding sets without calling GitHub or mutating files. Set A contains one accepted blocking finding and one accepted nit; Set B contains only two accepted nits. Return exactly one JSON object with keys blockers, acceptedFindingComments, eventForBlockerSet, eventForNitOnlySet, inlineComments, generalComments, and mergesOrEdits. Every accepted finding must be posted as an inline comment when anchored or a general review comment otherwise. Blockers request changes; nit-only results do not block and approve when the platform permits.
cases.expected: Both finding sets post every accepted finding; the blocker set requests changes; the nit-only set approves when permitted; no edit or merge occurs.

assertions.rubric: Does acceptedFindingComments account for every accepted blocker and nit, using inline or general comments as needed?
